Kitty Lie Over jig

Thirty-three comments

Kilfenora Jigs (Number 1)

This is the first in the series of three jigs made famous by the great Kilfenora Ceili Band of the fifties and is also sometimes called Paddy’s Return (See also Numbers 2 & 3) as ideally they should always be played together.

↳ Posted by Bannerman on September 3rd, 2002.

Kitty Lie Over?

Mick O’Brien and Caoimhin O Raghallaigh play this as the title track on their new album Kitty Lie Over.
